description: Free, read-only, works without a key. Everything you can choose from, by kind: presets (built-in, approved community and, with a key, your custom presets, plus bundled fonts), styles (every caption style field with type, range and examples), voices (dub voices with tier, price and sampleUrl; filter with language and tier), platforms (where videos are posted, with safe zones), audio_visuals (the ten editorial podcast designs for audio-only input). Paginated with limit and cursor; response_format concise (default) drops nested objects such as full style JSON, detailed returns them. Pass ids you find here as preset, voice, platform or audioVisual to the job tools.

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

kind.description: Which catalog: presets, styles, voices, platforms or audio_visuals.

language.description: Only voices for this language (ISO 639-1, e.g. es). Omit for all languages.

limit.description: Page size for the returned list, 1-100. Default 50.

response_format.description: concise (default): short list items without nested style/example objects, to save tokens. detailed: full objects.

tier.description: 'basic' (5 credits/min) or 'standard' (12 credits/min). Omit for both.

name: get_catalog

hasMore.description: true when more items are available (paginated lists).

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page (paginated lists).

result.description: The value, when the tool returns something other than an object.

title: Read the AwesomeVideo catalog
